intro: The language of the scientific method, and how to express certainty and doubt about a result.
p.hipótesis.consejo: The h is silent: «i-PO-te-sis». The plural is the same: «las hipótesis».
p.teoría.consejo: The last two vowels are separate syllables: «te-o-RI-a». «En teoría» hints that in practice it may differ.
p.investigador.consejo: Feminine: «investigadora». It comes from «investigar». The v sounds like b.
p.muestra.consejo: It also means «sign»: «una muestra de cariño». It comes from «mostrar».
p.dato.consejo: It is very often plural: «los datos». «Un dato» is a single piece of information.
p.comprobar.consejo: The o becomes ue: «compruebo», «compruebas». It is the same as «verificar».
p.confirmar.consejo: It is regular. You confirm an appointment, a story or a hypothesis.
p.descartar.consejo: It comes from «carta», like discarding a card in a game. You rule out an idea.
p.célula.consejo: The accent marks the stressed syllable: «THE-lu-la». Plants and animals are made of cells.
p.especie.consejo: It does not change in the plural: «la especie», «las especies». It sounds «es-PE-thye».
p.porcentaje.consejo: It is written «por ciento»: «el 40 por ciento» or «el 40 %». It is masculine.
p.estadística.consejo: It is feminine. «La estadística» is the science; «una estadística» is a numerical figure.
p.calcular.consejo: It is regular. It also means to guess: «calculo que llegaré tarde».
p.fórmula.consejo: The accent is on the o: «FOR-mu-la». There are maths and chemistry formulas.
b1.texto:
**The process.** An **investigador** starts from a question and proposes a **hipótesis**. To **comprobarla**, they collect **datos** and analyse them with the help of **estadística**. The results can **confirmar** the hypothesis or **descartarla**.

**Theory and hypothesis.** A **teoría** is an explanation strongly supported by evidence; a hypothesis is only an idea to be tested.

**Numbers.** With a **muestra** you only study a part. A **fórmula** is used to **calcular** the **porcentaje**. A **célula** or an **especie** can be the subject of the study.

**Certainty and doubt.** **Está claro que** + indicative; **no está claro que**, **es probable que** and **puede que** + subjunctive.
b2.f0.texto: Our hypothesis is that plants grow better with blue light.
b2.f1.texto: I have measured each plant and written down all the data.
b2.f2.texto: Work out the percentage of plants that have grown more.
b2.f3.texto: Almost half have grown more than expected.
b2.f4.texto: It is not clear that the light is the only cause.
b2.f5.texto: The temperature may also have an influence.
b2.f6.texto: Then we will repeat the trial with a larger sample.
b2.f7.texto: That way we can confirm the hypothesis or rule it out.
b4.texto:
**Certainty + indicative.** **Está claro que**, **es evidente que**, **es cierto que**: **Está claro que los datos son fiables.**

**Doubt + subjunctive.** **No está claro que**, **no es seguro que**, **dudo que**: **No está claro que el método funcione.**

**Possibility + subjunctive.** **Es probable que**, **puede que**, **quizá**: **Es probable que otros equipos repitan el estudio.**

With **creo que** you use the indicative; with **no creo que**, the subjunctive.
b4.e0.texto: It is clear that the data are reliable.
b4.e1.texto: It is not clear that the method works.
b4.e2.texto: It is likely that other teams will repeat the study.
b5.f0.texto: The laboratory smells of damp soil and clean plastic.
b5.f1.texto: Under a blue light, a hundred small pots form silent rows.
b5.f2.texto: Each stem carries a white label with a handwritten number.
b5.f3.texto: Irene measures the leaves with a thin ruler and notes the numbers in a notebook.
b5.f4.texto: Outside, a bird sings without stopping among the wet branches.
b5.f5.texto: At midday, the numbers fill the board like small black ants.
b5.f6.texto: The percentage of tall plants is higher in the blue row.
b5.f7.texto: Irene keeps looking at the data with a frown.
b5.f8.texto: A single sample does not prove a universal rule.
b5.f9.texto: Before celebrating anything, they will repeat the trial with another thousand pots.
b6.o0.refuerzo: It expresses certainty: it takes the indicative.
b6.o1.refuerzo: It expresses certainty: it takes the indicative.
b6.o2.refuerzo: Yes: «no está claro que» expresses doubt and takes the subjunctive.
b7.frase: No está claro que el método ____.
b7.o0.refuerzo: That is indicative; doubt takes the subjunctive.
b7.o2.refuerzo: After «no está claro que» the future is not used.
b7.pregunta: Which form does «no está claro que» take?
b8.frase: Todavía no se ha comprobado en otros laboratorios
b8.traduccion: It has not yet been verified in other laboratories
b9.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «descartar» is setting aside an idea that is not supported.
b9.o1.refuerzo: «Confirmar» is saying it is true; here the data do not support it.
b9.o2.refuerzo: You calculate a number, not a hypothesis.
b9.pregunta: What do you do with a hypothesis the data do not support?
b11.frase: Es probable que otros equipos ____ el estudio.
b11.o0.refuerzo: That is indicative; possibility takes the subjunctive.
b11.o1.refuerzo: That is future; after «es probable que» comes the subjunctive.
b11.pregunta: Which form does «es probable que» take?
b12.o0.refuerzo: That is a hypothesis as long as it is not tested.
b12.o1: una parte pequeña que representa el total
b12.o1.refuerzo: Yes: the sample is a part of the group being studied.
b12.o2: un número entre cero y cien
b12.o2.refuerzo: That is more like a percentage, not a sample.
b12.pregunta: What is a sample in a study?
p.crecen.consejo: Third person plural of «crecer»; the «c» before «e» sounds like «th».
p.medido.consejo: Past participle of «medir», to measure; it goes after «he».
p.anotado.consejo: Past participle of «anotar», to note down.
p.calcula.consejo: Third person of «calcular», to work out with numbers.
p.crecido.consejo: Past participle of «crecer»; «ha crecido» means has grown.
p.influya.consejo: Subjunctive of «influir» after «puede que», for a possibility.
p.podremos.consejo: Future of «poder» for «nosotros»; the stem becomes «podr-».
p.descartarla.consejo: «Descartar» means to rule out; «la» refers to «hipótesis».
p.fiables.consejo: Plural of «fiable», something you can trust.
p.repitan.consejo: Subjunctive of «repetir» after «que», for a possible action.
p.tallo.consejo: The stem of a plant holds up the leaves.
p.mide.consejo: Third person of «medir», to measure, in the present.
p.regla.consejo: A «regla» is a ruler; it also means a rule.
p.apunta.consejo: Third person of «apuntar», to write something down.
p.hormigas.consejo: «Hormiga» is an ant; the «h» is silent.
p.mirando.consejo: Gerund of «mirar», to look at: «sigue mirando» means keeps looking.
p.fruncidas.consejo: Feminine plural participle of «fruncir», agreeing with «cejas».
p.demuestra.consejo: Third person of «demostrar», to prove something; «mostrar» is inside it.
p.universal.consejo: Something that applies everywhere, like «universal» in English.
p.repetirán.consejo: Future of «repetir» for «ellos»: «-án» marks the future.
p.comprobado.consejo: Past participle of «comprobar», to check or verify something.
p.laboratorios.consejo: Plural of «laboratorio», a place for experiments.
p.descartas.consejo: Second person of «descartar», to rule out.
p.representa.consejo: «Representar» means to stand for: «representa el total» is the whole.
p.total.consejo: «El total» is all of it, the sum of all the parts.
